what_it_provides: Local Oran city guide. Two HTML tables: 35 city Line rows (Ligne / Depart / Arret 1 / Arret 2 / Terminus, French/local place names) and 7 'Destination gare routiere Bahia' rows (G1, G2, G3, S, H, 13, 103). Carries the only per-Operator statement found anywhere: the footnote 'Les lignes ETO : 101 - 37 - U - 102 - 23 - 69 - 2 - 53 - 23'. This page is the source both Wikipedia articles cite for their Line tables.
licence_or_terms_seen: None. Footer reads (c) 2010-2026 Guide Oran. No reuse or open-data statement; no robots/licence page linked from the article.

what_it_provides: Article 'Reseau de bus d'Oran'. Infobox: operator ETO, 42 lines, 175 km, 10 million passengers/year, 20 DA short / 30 DA long fare. Two tables: 35 city rows (one duplicated 'H') and 7 gare routiere El Bahia rows. Content is a near-copy of the GuideOran table. Last edited 3 September 2025.
licence_or_terms_seen: CC BY-SA 4.0 (Wikipedia default). The underlying facts are not the Operator's publication.

what_it_provides: Article 'شبكة خطوط حافلات وهران'. Much richer than the French one: about 52 city rows given as full Arabic corridor strings (ref + ordered place list + note), plus a 7-row Bahia-station table cited to GuideOran. Six rows carry an explicit ETO marker in the ref column ('2 ETO', '10 ETO', '23 ETO', '53 ETO', 'ETO 54', '69 ETO'); four of those refs (2, 23, 53, 69) ALSO appear as separate non-ETO rows with different corridors. Row 79 is annotated 'run by a private company'. This is the only Arabic-language Line naming found.
licence_or_terms_seen: CC BY-SA 4.0. The city-lines table rows carry no per-row citation; only the Bahia-station table is referenced (to GuideOran).

what_it_provides: CapDZ, 9 August 2026, 'Transport urbain a Oran - Deux nouvelles lignes renforcent la desserte d'El Braya et Gdyel'. Two current ETO service facts: line 69 now runs El Hamri - El Braya; a second, unnumbered line runs from station El Morchid to Gdyel with the gare routiere as terminus. Also: about 200 new buses allocated to the wilaya, part still idle pending driver/conductor recruitment; users asking ETO to publish timetables.
licence_or_terms_seen: None found; standard newspaper copyright, no reuse grant.

what_it_provides: Undated GuideOran news item (by H. Maalem): line 6 reactivated centre-ville - Maraval with ETUSO buses, line 16 reactivated shortly before, 21 urban/suburban lines put into service after about 100 new buses. Uses the older Operator name ETUSO.

Ouest Tribune, 7 July 2023: 'L'etablissement de transport d'Oran ETO' launched a Play Store app named 'Oran bus' for real-time tracking of ETO buses, alongside about fifty new buses. Confirms the Operator's full French name and that a tracking app is Operator-endorsed. No Line list, no package id.

Lead only. 'Oran Bus' by Deeper Tech, the app matching the Ouest Tribune description of the ETO tracking app. The Play Store listing returns HTTP 404 at check time, i.e. the app is unpublished or region-restricted; nothing could be read from it.

what_it_provides: The Ministry of Interior 'Infrastructures' monograph page cited by BOTH Wikipedia articles for the 175 km / network-size claim. Fetched: the site returns 'الصفحة غير موجودة' (page not found). The claim is therefore no longer verifiable at its cited URL; ar.wikipedia keeps a web.archive.org snapshot dated 2024-05-11. The URL's wilaya=20 parameter is also inconsistent with Oran being wilaya 31, so even the archived page needs checking before being trusted as an Oran source.
